articles.title: Rising Financial Impact Of Out-Of-Network Claims On Self-Funded Employers
articles.summary: Rising out-of-network healthcare and pharmacy claims are driving up unexpected expenditures for self-funded employers. This trend significantly strains employer-sponsored benefit budgets by bypassing negotiated network rates and fueling medical and pharmaceutical inflation. For businesses, this requires tighter plan guardrails, enhanced utilization management, and proactive steerage strategies to mitigate escalating financial exposure.
